units.source_text: 此诗有失言之处[\[16\]](#part1330.html#m16)，想是悲哀之极，方寸缭乱所致，皇上并不见罪。

en.t: There were some improper words in this poem, but His Majesty thought they must have come from the extremity of grief and a disordered heart, and did not hold them against her.

units.source_text: 皇上不欲令人看到伤心之色，努力隐忍，然而终于隐忍不了。

en.t: His Majesty did not want others to see his sorrowful face and struggled to restrain himself, but in the end he could not bear it.

units.source_text: 他历历回想初见更衣时的千种风流、万般恩爱。

en.t: He vividly recalled the countless charms and deep affection of the time when he first met the Intimate.

units.source_text: 那时节一刻也舍不得分离。

en.t: In those days, he could not bear to be apart from her even for a moment.

units.source_text: 如今形单影只，孤苦伶仃，自己也觉得怪可怜的。

en.t: Now he was alone with only his shadow, lonely and miserable, and even he found himself pitiable.

units.source_text: 他说：“太君不欲违背故大纳言遗嘱，故而遣女入宫。

en.t: He said, "The lady did not wish to go against the late Grand Counselor's will, and therefore sent her daughter into the palace.

units.source_text: 我为答谢这番美意，理应加以优遇，却终未实行。

en.t: To repay that kindness, I ought to have treated her with special favor, yet in the end I failed to do so.

units.source_text: 如今人琴具杳，言之无益矣！”

en.t: Now both the person and the music are gone beyond recall; it is useless to speak of it!"

units.source_text: 接着又说：“虽然如此，更衣已经生下小皇子，等他长大成人，老太君定有享福之日。

en.t: Then he continued, "Even so, the Intimate has already given birth to a young prince; when he grows to adulthood, the old lady will surely have days of happiness.
May she remain healthy and live long."
